name: @safe-shape/api
description: Endpoint catalogs, validated fetch clients, OpenAPI and API compatibility for SafeShape.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/http && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/json-schema && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/compat && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/http && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/json-schema && npm run build --workspace @safe-shape/compat && tsc --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .tmp/test/tests/*.test.js
